title: Incendiary Record Artists
description: Incendiary Record Artists — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Tipper Gourd

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Kill Sleazy E, Dice N'Cube, Witch Doctor Dray, Terminator aXe, Chuck D'ease, and Flay'Vor Filet in Dingbat Duhrill's Pad and return to Tipper Gourd in The Mutanous Malaise Mezzanine.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Tipper Gourd

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Original Fangstah Record Artists

Zone: The Mutanous Malaise

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Kill Sleazy E, Dice N'Cube, Witch Doctor Dray, Terminator aXe, Chuck D'ease, and Flay'Vor Filet in Dingbat Duhrill's Pad and return to Tipper Gourd in The Mutanous Malaise Mezzanine.

Offer:

I was just down in Dingbat Duhrill's Pad. Of course I was only there to make sure that every record had a sticker on it. Making others see things your way is hard work. I was taking a break and sipping on an Ol' 40 oz. health potion I tucked into a brown paper sack when I noticed Dorcas sneaking out with records under his arm.

This is such a kick to the kilt. Those stickers we placed on the records are having the reverse effect the Citizens Action Committee had hoped they would. Instead of stopping children from purchasing this filth, it has become quite fashionable to listen to this garbage. Why.....garbage like this could cause children to think independent thoughts and form their own opinion. We cannot allow this to happen.

You need to march down there and make an example of these so-called artists that Dorcas admires so much. There are two different musical groups who are blatantly flaunting this rude lifestyle.

The first group is originally from a dungeon west of Townston. They are calling themselves O.W.A. I believe that is short for Oroks With Attitudes. How vulgar! Find and censor Sleazy E, Dice N'Cube, and Witch Doctor Dray.

The other group is from east of Townston. Their crew is going by the name of Public Anima. I want you to do a stroll-by and take out Terminator aXe, Chuck D'ease, and Flay'Vor Filet.

Head back to The Mutanous Malaise Mezzanine as soon as you are done and talk to me, Tipper Gourd.

Turn-in:

I feel so much safer knowing that those hoodlums are no longer 'cold chillin' in Dingbat Duhrill's Pad. At this rate, people will be thinking just like me in no time. And there is nothing wrong with that. If people cannot police their own thoughts then I think it's high time I start to police their thoughts for them. And I think you need to come back and see me real soon.

Objectives:

  • Sleazy E
  • Dice N'Cube
  • Witch Doctor Dray
  • Chuck D'ease
  • Flay'Vor Filet
  • Terminator aXe

Client level range: 33–50
